sloka: दिशः सर्व अभिदावन्तम् वृक्ष षण्ड गतम् कपिम् ।द्Rष्ट्वा सर्वाणि भूतानि वसन्त इति मेनिरे ॥५-१४-१२॥
transliteration: diśaḥ sarva abhidāvantam vṛkṣa ṣaṇḍa gatam kapim ।dRṣṭvā sarvāṇi bhūtāni vasanta iti menire ॥5-14-12॥

translations.english: ﻿ Beholding that sprightly monkey running in all directions, its body covered with variegated blossoms fallen from the trees, all living beings there thought that it was Spring personified
